metadata.training_order: fixed cyclic supplied-row order, no shuffle
metadata.tape: train pixels FP32 bits, train labels uint32, test pixels FP32 bits
metadata.gradient_lowering: stream gradient entries after all delta1 values computed; pre-update dependencies preserved
metadata.initialization: all scratch explicitly zeroed (charged); seeded initial weights set as raw FP32 literals
metadata.query_layout: one query immediately after hot scalars/constants; receive, normalize, infer, and send after training

optimizer.name: adam
optimizer.bias_correction: global minibatch step t >= 1; per-step divisors 1-beta1**t and 1-beta2**t
optimizer.state: zero-initialized m and v arrays per parameter; div FP32 primitive
optimizer.sqrt: Newton-Raphson y0 = x + 1e-6, K = 8, y = 0.5*(y + x/y); add/mul/div only
